SalesThumb Review (2026): AI Shop Software for Tint, PPF & Detailers

SalesThumb is one of the more ambitious new operating systems aimed directly at tint, PPF, ceramic coating, detailing and wrap shops. It combines CRM, booking, quoting, payments, film inventory, warranties and customer communication with a growing AI layer for inbox triage, cancellation recovery, smart pricing and photo-based quoting. The feature list is unusually broad — but the product is also new enough that shops should separate published capability from proven long-term reliability.

WHY IT IS INTERESTING

SalesThumb is trying to collapse a surprising number of shop systems into one product: CRM, booking, proposals, payments, two-way messaging, customer galleries, film inventory, warranties, retention marketing, AI sales support and multi-location reporting.

WHY WE WOULD TEST BEFORE MIGRATING

The breadth is impressive, but this is still a young platform with limited independent track record. The official site also changes quickly enough that some pages can show older launch or migration messaging. A live demo and test migration matter more than the feature checklist.

DetailerFit verdict: SalesThumb is worth watching closely because it is not simply adding an AI chatbot to a generic CRM. Its strongest higher-tier features — slot-fill, smart pricing, photo-to-quote, AI inbox support, film-aware inventory and customer-retention workflows — are tied to real shop operations. The tradeoff is price: the headline $99/month plan is very different from the $399 Growth tier where the main text-AI suite starts and the $599 Pro tier required for vision AI.

What Is SalesThumb?

SalesThumb is shop-management software built specifically for automotive appearance and service businesses. Its current industry pages cover window tint, PPF, ceramic coating, auto detailing, vinyl wrap and general service.

The product is broader than a simple scheduler or CRM. SalesThumb currently publishes features across operations, AI, customer experience, growth and multi-location management. The strategic difference is that SalesThumb is trying to run both the transaction and the follow-up loop.

SalesThumb Pricing in 2026

SalesThumb currently lists four per-shop plans. There are also separate HQ and Franchise Sales add-ons.

PlanStandard priceCurrent intro offerBest fit
Basic$99/mo$79/mo for first 3 monthsOne-user, one-vertical shop needing core CRM / booking / invoicing
Starter$199/mo$159/mo for first 3 monthsSmall shop needing deposits, two-way SMS, galleries and 5 seats
Growth$399/mo$199/mo first year for eligible Founding 50 shopsMulti-service shop wanting the main text-AI suite and growth tools
Pro$599/mo$299/mo first year for eligible Founding 50 shopsShop wanting vision AI, photo-to-quote and heavier automation

SalesThumb also lists HQ at $599/month as a multi-location add-on and CRM / Franchise Sales at $799/month. Enterprise pricing is custom.

Do not compare SalesThumb on the $99 headline alone

Basic is a genuinely stripped-down tier: one user, one vertical, no outbound SMS/email, no deposits and no installer mobile app. The features that make SalesThumb strategically interesting begin mostly on Growth and Pro.

SalesThumb AI Features: What Is Actually Included?

SalesThumb's AI story is more substantial than a single chat assistant, but buyers need to distinguish the Growth text-AI suite from the Pro vision-AI suite.

Growth: AI embedded in the front office

  • My Day brief for daily operations.
  • Inbox triage and reply drafts for customer communication.
  • Suggest next service from customer history.
  • Slot-fill for canceled capacity.
  • Plain-English booking for natural-language scheduling.

Pro: vision AI and heavier automation

  • Photo-to-quote from a customer vehicle photo.
  • QC photo inspector as a quality-control aid.
  • AI dispute defender for evidence packaging.
  • AI warranty claim triage for issue classification.
  • AI Ops Assistant for multi-step audience and messaging workflows.

The useful question is not “does it have AI?” It is whether the AI operates inside a real shop workflow and respects the shop's approved prices, materials, service definitions and policies.

CRM, Booking and Payments

At its core, SalesThumb includes customer and vehicle records, calendar, booking, quotes, invoices, payments and job workflow. Good / better / best quotes begin on Starter, which fits premium services where customers choose between films, coating durations, PPF coverage or detail packages.

PlanPublished card-processing rate
Basic3.59% + $0.35 per tap
Starter2.99% + $0.30 per tap
Growth2.89% + $0.25 per tap
Pro2.79% + $0.20 per tap

For a higher-volume shop, payment economics can matter as much as the subscription price.

Film Inventory, Warranty and Shop Workflow

SalesThumb publishes film-roll tracking, reorder points, job-level material deduction, COGS reporting, warranty catalogs and workflow boards. Growth adds COGS reporting and AI-assisted reorder / purchase-order drafting. The platform also publishes U.S. state tint-law logic inside the quote workflow, including VLT-limit warnings and customer sign-off.

Customer Experience and Retention

  • Private job photo galleries for before/after delivery.
  • Tip-the-tech from the gallery flow.
  • Live job tracking for customers.
  • Magic-link customer portal with less password friction.
  • 12-month sales playbook for post-job follow-up.
  • Customer mobile app beginning on Growth.

This is strategically useful for appearance shops because a high-ticket first service can lead to maintenance, PPF, coating, tint or repeat detailing later.

Smart Pricing and Reporting

SalesThumb's smart pricing analyzes service-level quote close rates and flags potential raise, reduce or hold actions. That should be treated as a decision aid, not an automatic pricing authority: lead quality, seasonality, salesperson performance and response speed can all move conversion.

The reporting layer also publishes sales attribution, customer lifetime value, rebook rate, retention cohorts, churn risk, utilization, cancellation/no-show rate, technician efficiency and warranty metrics.

SalesThumb Strengths

  • Industry specificity: tint, PPF, ceramic, detailing and wrap are explicit verticals.
  • AI tied to workflows: messaging, quoting, scheduling, QC and retention rather than one generic bot.
  • Material / COGS focus: higher tiers go beyond basic inventory.
  • Customer experience: galleries, tips, live tracking and portals are built into the flow.
  • Multi-service support: Growth and Pro can combine supported verticals.
  • Multi-location ambition: HQ and franchise-development tools go beyond most detailing CRMs.
  • Transparent pricing: plan prices and many processing rates are public.

Risks and Unanswered Questions

  • Limited independent track record: most available information still comes from SalesThumb itself.
  • Fast-changing public documentation: some pages still contain launch-era language while the main site and pricing page present the product as available.
  • Migration messaging is not perfectly consistent: the homepage describes fast migrations, while the pricing FAQ gives a longer 10–14 day figure for many single-location migrations.
  • AI accuracy needs real testing: photo-to-quote and QC must work on your vehicles, lighting, materials, labor and edge cases.
  • Higher-tier cost: the most differentiated AI and growth features are not on the $99 plan.
  • Payment economics: high card volume can materially change total software cost.

Before migrating

Ask SalesThumb to run five recent real jobs through the system: a maintenance detail, ceramic coating, tint package, full-front PPF and a higher-ticket mixed-service job. Compare quote creation, inventory deduction, customer messaging, payment cost and final reporting with your current software.

Which SalesThumb Plan Makes Sense?

Basic — $99/month

Best for a one-person shop that mainly needs CRM, calendar, public booking, simple quotes/invoices and payments. It is not the plan to buy because of SalesThumb's AI marketing.

Starter — $199/month

More realistic for a small premium-service business because it adds deposits, two-way SMS, quote tiers, galleries, customer tracking and five seats. Still single-vertical.

Growth — $399/month

This is where SalesThumb becomes meaningfully differentiated. Multi-vertical support, the main text-AI suite, smart pricing, customer app, marketing tools, COGS and inventory automation begin here.

Pro — $599/month

Pro is the plan for shops specifically interested in the vision-AI story. Photo-to-quote, QC photo inspection, dispute tools, warranty AI and unlimited seats are the main reasons to consider the jump.

Does SalesThumb Have an Affiliate Program?

We did not find a publicly listed SalesThumb affiliate or referral program during our September 16, 2026 source check.

However, SalesThumb's official contact page explicitly says it accepts partnership inquiries and lists info@roffik.com as a direct contact address. That makes direct outreach more promising than assuming no partnership is available.

Final Verdict

SalesThumb is one of the more aggressive attempts to redefine automotive appearance software around an AI-assisted front office instead of a conventional calendar-and-invoice CRM.

The strongest reason to test it is the way its AI connects to concrete shop problems: empty slots, unanswered messages, pricing decisions, photo-based quote drafts, film inventory and post-job retention. The strongest reason to be cautious is that this is still a fast-moving emerging platform and most available evidence remains vendor-published.

Our conclusion: established multi-service tint / PPF / ceramic / detailing shops evaluating a new operating system should put SalesThumb on the demo list, especially while the Founding 50 promotion remains available. Smaller solo operators should compare the true feature tier they need against lower-cost alternatives rather than anchoring on the $99 entry price.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is SalesThumb?

SalesThumb is shop-management software for tint, PPF, ceramic coating, auto detailing, vinyl wrap and related businesses. It combines CRM, scheduling, booking, quoting, invoicing, payments, inventory, customer communication, reporting and AI tools.

How much does SalesThumb cost?

Current standard pricing is $99/month for Basic, $199 for Starter, $399 for Growth and $599 for Pro per shop. Promotional pricing may reduce the first few months or first year for eligible shops.

Does the $99 SalesThumb plan include the main AI tools?

No. Basic includes the AI monthly story, but the main text-AI suite begins on Growth. Vision AI, including photo-to-quote, is listed on Pro.

Which SalesThumb plan supports multiple service verticals?

Growth and Pro support multiple verticals. Basic and Starter are listed as single-vertical plans.

Is SalesThumb good for PPF and tint shops?

It is designed for them and publishes film inventory, warranty, tint-law and multi-day workflow features. Because the platform is still emerging, shops should test those workflows with real materials and real jobs before migrating.

Does SalesThumb have an affiliate program?

DetailerFit did not find a public affiliate program during this review. The company's contact page accepts partnership inquiries, so direct outreach may be the best path.
